main_text.p: tio, Marc. 1.7. Luc. 3.16. Act. 13,25. & 19.4. mors, Matth. 14. 10. Marc. 6.27. sepultura, Matt. 14.12. Marc. 6.29. in Baptil-ma Iohannis baptizari quid sit Vide Baptizare.

IOHANNES Zebedei filius, vocatur à Christo, Matt. 4.21. Mar. 1.19. Luc. 5.9. Christo dilectus est, Ioan. 13:23. & 19.26. & 20.2. & 21.20. in Samariam mittitur, Act. 8.14. se Christi seruum vocat, Apoc. 1.1.
IOHANNES, qui & Marcus, Actor. 12.12. à Paulo & Barnaba cooptatur, v. 25. & 13.5. ab iis dimissus Ierosolymam redit, vers. 13. Barnabam solum comitatur, 15. v. 37. 39.

IOIDA Sacerdos cum Centurionibus & Decurionibus de liberandis religione & rege, sanctè conspirat, 2. Reg. 11. 4. 2. Paral. 23. 1. illis Dauidis arma distribuit, 2 Reg. 11. 10. 2. Paral. 23. 9. Regem in medium prolatum inungit, & impositâ corona consecrat, 2. Reg. 11. 12. 2. Paral. 22. 11. Athaliam è templo detrusam occidi iuber, 2. Reg. 11. 15. 2. Paral. 23. 14. de vero Dei cultu restituendo cum Rege & Populo pacisci tur, 2 Reg. 11. 17. 2 Paral. 23. 16. eo docente & viuente Rex pietatem colit, 2 Reg. 12. 2. 2. Paral. 24. 2. Vxorem ex stirpe regia duxerat, 2 Paral. 22. 11. moritur, 24. 15. regio sepulchro propter vitae sanctimoniam honoratur, 24. 16. eo mortuo Principes adulatores Regis mores corrumpùt, v. 17. 18. (Iehoiad a. i. scientia Domini.)
IONADAB prudens, carnalis, & nequam, Ammonis amicus, 2 Sam. 13. 3. mali consilij Amnomi autor est, v. 5. (i. Domini munificentia.)
IONADAB, filius Rechab, Iehu partes in delenda idololatria sequitur, 2 Reg. 10 v. 15. 16. 17.

IONAS (Ionah. 1. columba) Propheta, 2 Reg. 14. 25. vocatio Ionae, Ion. 1. 1. eam vt fugiat, in Tharsim se recipit, v. 3. in mare deiicitur, v. 15. à pisce absorbetur, 2. 1. eius ventre tribus naturalibus diebus continetur, v. 2. illinc Deum orans exauditur, v. 3. & liberatur, v. 11. Niniuitis suam praedicit ruinam, 3. 4. Ionas typus Christi, Matt. 12. 39. 40. & 16. 4. Luc. 11. 30. Ionae ira, & eius oratio ob Niniuen seruatam, 4. v. 1. 2. à Deo damnatur, v. 4.
IONATHAN, Mosis ex Gersone nepos, idoli Sacerdos, Iudic. 18. 30. (1. à Deo datus, vel Domini donum.)
IONATHAN Dauidis patruus, gigantem viginti quatuor digitos in manibus, & pedibus habentem occidit, 1. Paral. 20. v. 6. 7. eius prudentia laudatur, 27. 32.

page.notes: Right-hand edge shows fragments of the facing page (show-through and adjacent page text) and was not transcribed. Several words are uncertain due to the scan quality, notably "corrumpùt", "Niniuitis", and the Latin numerals in the references.
